title: Two Sum
description: Given an array of integers nums and an integer target, return the indices of two numbers that add up to target.

title: Valid Palindrome
description: Given a string, determine whether it reads the same forward and backward, ignoring non-alphanumeric characters and case.

examples.input: s = "A man, a plan, a canal: Panama"
examples.explanation: After normalization, the string is a palindrome.

title: Binary Search
description: Given a sorted array of integers and a target, return the index of the target. Return -1 if it is not present.

examples.explanation: The target 9 is present at index 4.

constraints: nums is sorted in ascending order

title: Maximum Subarray
description: Given an integer array nums, find the contiguous subarray with the largest sum and return that sum.

examples.explanation: The subarray [4, -1, 2, 1] has the largest sum, which is 6.

title: Longest Substring Without Repeating Characters
description: Given a string s, find the length of the longest substring without repeating characters.

examples.explanation: The longest substring is "abc", with length 3.

constraints: s contains English letters, digits, symbols and spaces
